>>A<< RIVET INSTALLATION
1. Insert the rivet [φ4.8 mm (φ0.19 inch)] into the top cover side 
strap and control link.
2. Insert "A" of the rivet into the rivet tool. 
3. Pressing the flange surface of the rivet, move the handle of 
the rivet tool.
4. The thinnest point of "A" is cut and the rivet is held in the 
position.
